Protocol 2000 - Cancer / Life-Threatening

Protocol mms miracle-mineral-solution prostate men-health

Evidence: Grade C (traditional_use)

Summary

MMS protocol for cancer and life-threatening diseases using increased dosing with MMS2 (Protocol 2000). 10-hour daily dosing with MMS1, MMS2 added day 3-4.

Indications

  • cancer
  • life-threatening-diseases
  • severe-conditions

Contraindications

  • pregnancy
  • kidney-disease
  • severe-heart-conditions

Dosage

10 hours daily dosing with MMS1, MMS2 added day 3-4 (Protocol 2000). More than 90% recovery rate reported.

Frequency: 10 hours daily
